lines: Thus drawn by jala-practice, the jīva, entered
dārbha, jasmine-fruit or body, becomes; nor trembles,
equipment absent; but by that contemplation's force
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jālaprayogākṛṣṭo jīvo dārbhaṃ jātīphalādi vā śarīraṃ samāviṣṭo bhavati na ca spandate manaḥpraṇādisāmagryabhāvāt tadanudhyānabalāt tu spandate 'pi tādṛśe 'pi tasmin pūrvavat prokṣaṇādisaṃskāraḥ pūrṇāhutiyojanikāntaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What becomes of the drawn jīva, and does he tremble? → Entered-body samāviṣṭa has no spanda (sāmagrī-absence) yet has tadanudhyāna-bala spanda — the double movement ends in prokṣaṇa-saṃskāra within pūrṇāhuti-yojanā.
c1_essence: The drawn jīva enters dārbha or body without tremble, yet trembles by contemplation's force — consecration within the full-offering's yojana-end.
